method: Anonymous HTTPS .idx inventory; selected and CAPE/CIN candidate messages decoded from HTTP byte ranges with ecCodes 2.41.0. Parameter/level/step index identities are copied exactly from NOAA indexes; GRIB2 codes, units, level types and step metadata are stored where resolved. Parcel semantics remain unverified. Expanded scan records other live f00 products, including HRRR wrfnat, RAP awp/wrf products, and RRFS prslev/2dfld variants. VUCSH/VVCSH units are s**-1 and are not treated as m s**-1 bulk wind differences.
